purpose: List, filter, inspect, fixture-test, exactly resolve, and plan unique exact-interface assemblies from installed executable software-organ packages without treating descriptive anatomy as implementation.

properties.ref: optional exact package reference in id@version form; returns the complete inspectable source package
properties.test_ref: optional exact package reference in id@version form; renders and deterministically checks its declared v0.2 fixtures in disposable project space
properties.project_type: optional exact project-type filter when listing
properties.provides: optional exact provided-interface filter when listing
properties.organ_goal: optional exact axm.interface-organ-goal/v0.1 object; returns bounded interface-driven assembly READY or HOLD evidence without publishing files

relationships: validates exact package schema, identity, version, template parameters, interfaces, provenance, and project types
runs only declared v0.2 deterministic fixtures in disposable project space and labels v0.1 packages as schema-only evidence
resolves only exact installed id@version references
discovers a unique smallest complete package set only from exact required, provided, and transitive interface contracts
returns ambiguity, missing-interface contracts, binding gaps, cycles, collisions, and search bounds as explicit HOLD evidence
keeps the 415 descriptive anatomy organ records separate from executable package truth

anatomy_refs.basis: The capability loads and validates versioned executable-organ package manifests with a fixed schema, exact parameter/template agreement, supported project types, inspectable source, interfaces, provenance, and limitations.
The exact local package index makes composable executable organ capabilities discoverable, but does not replace the existing routed live-capability registry.

limitations: installed packages are resolved by exact reference/filter or selected only through a unique complete exact-interface constraint solution; semantic and fuzzy selection are not implemented
package schema and declared fixture validation do not prove source-level interface conformance, untested bindings, or runtime behavior
packages are local UTF-8 JSON source bodies; binary asset packages are not implemented
descriptive anatomy records do not become executable by name or proximity
persistent_state: installed executable-organ package JSON files are part of the inspectable machine source body

truth.basis: The installed source path, exact ref, schema, parameters, interfaces, provenance, limitations, and descriptive-versus-executable boundary remain inspectable.

agency.basis: Humans or AIs explicitly choose required interfaces and instance values; only one uniquely smallest exact-contract assembly may be derived, while ambiguity remains a visible choice.

continuity.basis: Versioned package references let working organs remain reusable across later creations without rewriting earlier package source.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The machine distinguishes installed executable source from descriptive candidates before increasing apparent capability counts.
